info.name: Sign In Solutions VMS AuditLogs Registrations API

params.name: include
params.description: A list of comma-separated related models to include

items.docs: Gets the details of a single instance of a `Registration`

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the results to a specified number, defaults to 50

params.name: offset
params.description: Offsets the results to a specified number, defaults to 0

params.name: location_ids
params.description: A comma separated list of Location IDs

params.name: created_before
params.description: Restricts results to only those that were created before the provided date

params.name: created_after
params.description: Restricts results to only those that were created after the provided date

params.name: needs_confirmation
params.description: A confirmed `Registration` is one with an associated `Invite`. This filter returns those without an `Invite` when true, and those with an `Invite` when false.

items.docs: Gets a list of all `Registration` entities.
